mechanics.claim: Heroic Charge deals damage and carries the target on the initial hit, and if they hit terrain it deals the same damage again and stuns.
mechanics.quote: she deals {{as|physical damage}} and {{tip|airborne|carries}} them along with her for up to 400 units.

mechanics.claim: Both instances of damage and the wall stun are the same cast instance for on-cast effects.
mechanics.quote: Both instances of damage and crowd control are all the same {{tip|cast instance}}. Effects that only trigger once per spell cast will not trigger twice.

mechanics.claim: If the target leaves a certain radius before Poppy reaches them, she does not carry or deal damage to them.
mechanics.quote: '''Poppy''' does not {{tip|airborne|carry}} nor deal damage to the target if they have left a certain radius before she collides with them.

mechanics.claim: The spell can be blocked by a spell shield.
